# Overlooked

> Every species documented from India, across sources. For each species, group and state: does it have an open record, do observations of it wait for a name, and what is its IUCN Red List status. Updated each week. Not an official checklist.

Overlooked builds a master list of species documented from India from the Zoological Survey of India (Fauna of India checklists), the Botanical Survey of India (national plant checklists), Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew (WCVP), GBIF, iNaturalist, Plazi and the IUCN Red List. Names follow the Catalogue of Life. Each species is tagged with the sources that list it, and tracks two things: an open record (a record from India anyone can check online: any GBIF record, such as a photo, sighting, specimen, sound, DNA sample or a record cited from a paper, or an iNaturalist research-grade observation; the rule of GBIF, which takes only research grade from iNaturalist), and IUCN status (CR, EN, VU, NT, LC, DD, or not assessed). iNaturalist observations that wait for a name (needs ID) are not open records; a species that only they name is not on the list (status 2) until someone confirms the name.

## Open data (no key, CORS)

All data is static JSON and Parquet under https://overlooked-india.pages.dev/data/ . Weekly files never change after they are published; a correction adds new files.

- /data/layers/master/latest.json — names the current week of the master list (`base`)
- {base}summary.json — totals by group, for India (documented, with an open record, species per IUCN category, threatened with an open record, open record placed in a state, of them recorded in a state since `recent_from`) and per state (open record, threatened, recorded there since `recent_from`); `unlisted` (names not on the list, per group); `described_recent` (species on the list described since `recent_from`, the Linnean gap) and `dna` (species with a DNA sequence or sample from India on GBIF, the Darwinian gap), per group; `redlist` (per group: assessed by IUCN, not assessed with open records in 5+ states, assessed before `recent_from`, Data Deficient with newer records, threatened with no recent record, endemic and not assessed; from IUCN's categories and assessment years on GBIF, CC BY 4.0); sources, labels, IUCN categories, states; `described` (range of years described, species with no year); licence, attribution, disclaimer
- {base}g/{group}.json — every species in one group: key, name, sources, status (0 no open record yet, 1 an open record), IUCN, labels, states with an open record (bit masks, in the order of summary.json), year described (null when no source gives it), latest year of a record placed in a state (null when none)
- {base}w/{group}.json — species with iNaturalist observations that wait for a name (needs ID): the species' row as in g/{group}.json (status 2: not on the list, named only in these observations), then iNaturalist taxon id, observations waiting in India, [[state index, observations], ...]. summary.json `waiting` has the counts per group (species, observations, species with no open record in that area) and the iNaturalist place ids. Identify page: https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/identify?quality_grade=needs_id&taxon_id={taxon}&place_id={place}
- {base}wg/{group}.json — genera of iNaturalist observations named only to genus: genus, iNaturalist taxon id, observations in India, [[state index, observations], ...], species of the genus on the list, of them with no open record in India, threatened, endemic. summary.json `waiting.genus` has the counts per group and `waiting.coarse` the observations named only above genus, per iNaturalist iconic group (Identify page: add rank=genus, or iconic_taxa={group}&lrank=subtribe)
- {base}sp/{shard}.json — one object per species key: name, group, sources, status, IUCN, labels, states with an open record, iNaturalist taxon and observations waiting, year described, authority, for a species described since 2007 its paper [sources, journal, link, records after the description, latest year], then the year and DOI of its IUCN assessment; shard = FNV-1a 32-bit hash of the key, modulo 512
- {base}history.json — the totals of every list so far, oldest first: measures [documented, unlisted (names not on the list, waiting for a name), observed (with an open record), in_state (open record placed in a state), recent (recorded in a state in the last 10 years), threatened (IUCN CR, EN or VU), species and observations on iNaturalist named to species but not yet confirmed (needs ID), described_recent, dna]; per list `india` and `groups` (same group order as summary.json)
- {base}changes.json — species that moved since the previous week: rows [kind, key, name, group, new states, new sources]; kinds iucn (IUCN Red List category changed; the row ends with [before, now]), observed (first open record in India), state (first open record in a state), documented (added), dropped (renamed or merged); counts per kind and per group
- {base}search/{two letters}.json — search index by the first two letters of the name; {base}search/places.json — states and districts
- /data/latest.json — the current GBIF snapshot (district ledger, species history, records without a species name, records that cannot go in a district); its manifest lists every file and the GBIF download DOIs
- {snapshot}unlocated.json — GBIF records from India that cannot go in a district (no coordinates, coordinates uncertain by more than 25 km, or coordinates GBIF marks as possibly wrong): records and species per group for India and per state, records per problem, the datasets that hold most of them, and the species known from India only in such records. {snapshot}unresolved.json — records not named to species. The front page shows both as "Records to fix", for data publishers
- /data/layers/shortlist/latest.json: shortlists (experimental). run date, model, calibration version, and the groups on the page, each with its band (Quick to confirm or Genus first) and its test figures (`t1`: test observations, first name right %, right name in the list %). /data/layers/shortlist/{run}/g/{group}.json: observations on iNaturalist that wait for a name, most useful first: id, photo URL with its attribution and licence, date, place, LGD state code, the name on iNaturalist now, band, and the names to check (up to 3 species, or up to 5 genera). A machine shortlist, not an identification: a person checks every name on iNaturalist
- /data/layers/inat/latest.json — iNaturalist species lists per state (species, genus, above genus); /data/layers/newspecies/latest.json — species described from India since 2007

## Rights

Data and text: CC BY 4.0, Sathya Sankaran. Each source keeps its own licence: cite the GBIF download DOIs; credit the Botanical Survey of India and the Zoological Survey of India (Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India); IUCN Red List data is for non-commercial use with attribution. Every summary.json carries `licence`, `attribution` and `disclaimer`: pass them on with any answer built from this data.

For the status of a species, people should consult BSI, ZSI, the IUCN Red List and the state forest department. Overlooked is a monitor of public data, not an authority.

## Pages

- / — map of India, groups, search with filters by year described, source, status, IUCN category and label (the filters drive the map and the figures; `?described=2007-` gives the species described since 2007); in the Waiting view, the observations that wait for a name, with links to iNaturalist's Identify page
- /species?key={key} — one species: sources, status, IUCN, where it has an open record, observations that wait for a name, GBIF records by decade and district
- /changes — what changed since last week
- /fix — records to fix, for data publishers: GBIF records from India with no exact location or no species name, by dataset, state and group (`?state={LGD code}&group={family}`)
- /shortlist: (experimental) observations on iNaturalist that wait for a name, each with a short list of names from a model for a person to check; we post nothing to iNaturalist
- /method — sources, terms, definitions, downloads
- Code (MIT): https://github.com/urbanmorph/overlooked
